ar.story: أبدأ بفهم المشكلة والسياق قبل كتابة الكود. أهتم بما يحتاجه المستخدم، وما يحتاجه العمل، ثم أختار أبسط بنية قادرة على خدمة الاثنين.

en.title: Product thinking, backed by engineering rigor.
en.intro: I’m a full-stack developer helping founders and teams build clear, fast web products ready to grow.
en.story: I start by understanding the problem and its context before writing code. I look at what the user needs, what the business needs, then choose the simplest architecture that can serve both.

values.title: Direction first
values.text: Every technical decision connects to a clear product goal.

values.title: Performance is UX
values.text: Speed and reliability are not postponed enhancements.

values.title: Built for change
values.text: Clear systems that teams can evolve with confidence.

values.title: Practical quality
values.text: Testing and documentation where they truly protect the product.
